tara: Quick sync re: Crescendo joint POC. Partner wants a 5-day shared sandbox with SAML SSO, sample telemetry export, and a small reserved commit. Can we confirm constraints and next steps?
liam: We can do SAML for tenant-level SSO. Need partner ACS URL + cert. For POC, SAML can be prod-like.
esther: Telemetry options: cross-account Kinesis or read-only S3 export. Partner prefers Kinesis to stream events into their analytics. Ops needs IAM ARNs.
ops-oncall: Kinesis is fine. We'll provide a cross-account policy and a short retention pipeline (default 30d). We must ensure request payload masking for PII. Also note rate limits during POC: max sustained 150 rps, bursts to 400 for 5m.
liam: Infra note: for shared POC we'll provision a dedicated staging pool (3x vGPU, autoscale to 6) under a partner tenant. That avoids noisy neighbor issues.
billing-ops: For pricing, recommend a POC credit of $3,000 and an optional small reserved commit for 2 vGPUs/month as a trial pricing line. Partner asked about co-sell discount; propose 25% for first quarter.
tara: Legal/exports flagged a question about model export controls and whether embeddings leave the EU. @legal can you confirm wording for the questionnaire?
legal: We'll answer export controls and provide the EU residency doc. If they export logs out of region, we need DPA addendum.
esther: Partner also asked about HSM. Clarify: BYOK with Cloud KMS works for hosted; on-prem HSM requires Redwood Private deployment.
liam: Can someone paste a minimal curl the partner can use to smoke test routing and SSO? Keep it tiny.
ops-oncall: Use this (replace <TOKEN>):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-small","input":"status","max_tokens":3}'
Expected: {"status":"ok","result":"up"}
billing-ops: I'll attach a draft quote to the runbook. Need expected avg tokens/hr. liam, can you provide?
liam: Estimate: avg 1.2M tokens/day peak -> include batching and caching to lower cost. I'll drop numbers in shared sheet.
deploy-bot: Runbook ticket CRE-901 created and assigned to liam.
tara: Runbook call set for Fri 9am PT. Agenda: tenant provisioning, SAML handshake, telemetry role, quote review, POC SLA. Please bring final docs. :thumbsup:
